caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden mantle clock with a rich reddish-brown color. The body of the clock features a classical design with two vertical columns on each side and a wider base and top with decorative moldings. The clock face is located in the upper center section, framed in gold, displaying black Roman numerals on a white background, and includes two black hands showing the time. Below the clock face, there is a rectangular panel with a light blue or grayish reflective surface, resembling glass, bordered in gold. At the base center of the clock, there is a circular element with a dark blue, possibly metallic, interior that may represent the pendulum’s viewing window, bordered with gold. The clock is shown against a plain, undetailed background that is light beige or off-white.
title: Seth Thomas Clock
